title: Ocelot on full .Net framework 4.6.1 fails to create HttpClient and use
author: tsirkin

comments.body:
Created a pull request for this
Thanks for the great project

Dear @TomPallister  
Since you merged my fix for the issue could you please release a new nuget package for it?
I plan to use Ocelot in our project and the issue is a show stopper for me as I can't use SAML2 lib which depends on .Net full fr.
Thanks
@tsirkin thanks for reminding me I will do a release next week!

satisfaction_conditions: A fix that allows Ocelot to work properly on .NET Framework 4.6.1
A new official NuGet package release containing the fix
Compatibility with SAML2 libraries that depend on full .NET Framework

_classification.category: Can be dockerized without any issue
